brief:
Former US National Security Adviser Jake Sullivan faced student protesters during a speaking engagement at MIT, according to Al Jazeera English. The confrontation occurred as Sullivan addressed the audience at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.

Details of the specific demands or statements made by the protesters were not immediately reported. Sullivan served as national security adviser under President Joe Biden before departing the administration.
dek: Former US National Security Adviser Jake Sullivan was confronted by student protesters during a speaking event at MIT.
title: Students confront former US security adviser over Gaza
